title: What's in Legacy Wealth Blueprint
keyLine: A 12-month written plan for the income you already earn. Tuition stays off this page.
description: What Legacy Wealth Blueprint includes, Preston Seo's path from W-2 debt to a $15M+ portfolio, who the plan fits, and questions to ask before a call. No public tuition.
answer: Legacy Wealth Blueprint is our 12-month wealth plan. You get a written Wealth Strategy Snapshot built from your income, accounts, debt, and goals. You also get a dedicated guide, weekly coaching, a CPA Implementation Brief you hand to your own preparer, and lifetime lessons. Preston Seo built the system after a corporate job, a house-hacked duplex, and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife. We do not publish tuition on this page. Confirm it on a strategy call. This is a briefing, not a star review.

blocks.heading: Who built this
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about/preston-seo) founded Legacy Investing Show. His parents were first-generation immigrants. After college he took a corporate job and left within a year. The [about page](/about) says he then studied taxes, cash flow, investing, and ownership. He started with a house-hacked duplex while working sales. He left that job later and, with his wife, built a $15M+ real estate portfolio. Seven years sit between debt in 2017 and that portfolio figure today.
The portfolio is the result. The system underneath it is the thing he teaches: tax, debt, income, investing, and protection in one order, not one tactic.
Named client work is on [reviews](/reviews). This page will not paste those stories as a substitute for reading them.

blocks.heading: What the 12 months include
paragraphs: From the [Blueprint page](/legacy-wealth-blueprint): a custom Wealth Strategy Snapshot, a dedicated Legacy Wealth Guide with an onboarding call and check-ins, weekly live coaching with replays, the Wealth Circle community for 12 months, an optional prior-year tax return review plus a CPA Implementation Brief, 100+ lessons for life with templates and the Legacy Wealth AI Advisor, a partner network at client pricing (separate fees, confirm before you hire), and a second seat for a spouse or direct family member.
You keep your CPA. We do not sign Form 1040. The brief is homework you hand to the person who files.

The program is built for people earning $100K or more, whether that is a salary, self-employment, or a business. You do not have to buy a rental or start a company on day one. Which moves apply depends on your file.

blocks.heading: Buyer scorecard
blocks.intro: Print this. If you cannot check most boxes, do not book a call this week.
items: I can pay for a year of coaching without new credit-card debt.
I have last year's tax return, or an IRS transcript, in a folder.
I want a written 12-month order, not a one-off rental tactic.
I already have, or I will hire, a CPA or enrolled agent to file.

My 401(k) match is on, or I can explain why it is not. 2026 employee deferral limit is $24,500 ([IRS IR-2025-111](https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/401k-limit-increases-to-24500-for-2026-ira-limit-increases-to-7500)).
I can name the leak: tax, debt, idle cash, or a rental.
I read the [FTC coaching page](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) and I will not be rushed on a call.
I looked at [reviews](/reviews) for named client work, not star widgets on this URL.

blocks.label: How we talk about cost
paragraphs: We do not list our tuition on compare pages. Competitor prices you see elsewhere on this hub are copied from their public sites, dated. Our fee is confirmed in writing on a strategy call. Free entry is the [tax strategies class](https://join.managemoney101.com/tax-strategies).

whoFits: You earn well and you want tax, debt, and investing in one written order.
You want to know what Blueprint includes before a call, without shopping a sticker on Google.
whoSkips: You want a Preston Seo star review. See [reviews](/reviews) for client interviews.
You still carry high-interest credit-card debt. Finish that first. See [FOO or Ramsey vs a wealth plan](/compare/money-guy-foo-vs-ramsey-baby-steps).
You only want Airbnb training. That is a different offer, not Blueprint.

faqs.q: How much does Legacy Wealth Blueprint cost?
faqs.a: We do not publish the tuition on this page. Ask on a strategy call and get it in writing before you pay.
No. Keep a CPA or enrolled agent. We write a plan and a brief. They sign the return.

faqs.q: Is this only for real estate investors?
faqs.a: No. The Blueprint page says it is built for people earning $100K or more, including W-2. Real estate is one tool in the plan, not the whole plan.
